about_the_game:
From preparing laddoos to planting fruit seeds in your garden, this game is packed with excitement for cooking lovers who love Bheem cartoons and Chhota Bheem adventures.

In ChhotaBheem Kitchen Adventures, you will help Bheem, Chutki, Raju, Jaggu, Kalia, Dholu-Bholu, and even Tun Tun Mausi in their everyday cooking journey. You can cook delicious dishes, serve customers from juice centres, jalebi stalls, gulab jamun shops, and lassi counters, and also enjoy exploring the Dholakpur forest to collect flowers and fruits.

ur goal is simple:

  • Cook fast and serve hungry customers.

  • Decorate your bedroom with flowers, wall frames, and pots.

  • Grow your garden by planting seeds of flowers and fruit trees, including mango, orange, and apple!

  • Unlock adventurous levels where Bheem and friends go beyond cooking to explore forest adventures.

Key Features

Cooking Adventure with Chhota Bheem

Join Chhota Bheem and Chutki as they prepare laddoos, jalebi, juice, gulab jamun, and lassi for the people of Dholakpur. Sometimes when Tun Tun Mausi is not at home, Chutki takes big orders for laddoos and surprises the customers with her cooking skills.

Plant Seeds in Your Garden

Build your dream garden by planting seeds — from fruits like mango, orange, and apple to flowers like rose and sunflower. Watch them grow into beautiful plants and trees that give rewards. Collect your harvest and use it in your recipes.

Explore Dholakpur Forest

Go on a great adventure with Bheem, Chutki, and friends. Explore the magical Dholakpur forest, collect flowers and fruits, and exchange them in stores to buy seeds. This mode brings the charm of Chhota Bheem jungle adventures into your kitchen fun!

Bedroom & Home Decoration

Upgrade your bedroom with different wall décors, flower pots, and frames. Add creative touches to make your room as vibrant as your cooking. This feature is designed to entertain creativity and let kids express themselves.

Play with All Your Favorite Characters

  • Bheem – the strong and brave hero.

  • Chutki – always ready to cook laddoos, prepare juice, jalebi, gulab jamun and plant fruits.

  • Raju – the cute kid who loves adventure.

  • Jaggu – the playful monkey.

  • Kalia – always competing with Bheem.

  • Dholu-Bholu – the mischievous twins.

  • Tun Tun Mausi – famous for her laddoos.

  • Indumati – adding royal charm to Dholakpur.

Together they make every level a fun-filled Chhota Bheem adventure.

Rewards & Upgrades

Earn coins, laddoos, and gems to unlock new recipes, upgrade your kitchen tools, decorate your room, and plant more fruit seeds.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Fun cooking game with Chhota Bheem and friends.

  • A mix of cooking, gardening, and adventurous levels.

  • Collect laddoos, fruits, and flowers for rewards.

  • Decorate your room to entertain creativity.

  • Explore the Dholakpur forest in a thrilling side adventure.

  • Simple controls, perfect for kids and families.

Optimized for Cooking Lovers

If you love Chhota Bheem wala cartoon game you will enjoy this challenge in the kitchen journey. Packed with laddoos, fruit planting, and great adventures in Dholakpur, this game promises hours of entertainment.

With Chhota Bheem Kitchen Adventures, cooking becomes fun, gardening becomes magical, and every mission turns into an adventurous level.

Start Cooking, Planting & Exploring Today!

Download ChhotaBheem Kitchen Adventures now and join Bheem, Chutki, and the gang in a journey full of laddoos, fruit planting, Dholakpur adventures, and fun creativity.

Cook, plant, decorate, and explore — your great adventure in Dholakpur begins today!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Runs well on most modern MacBooks and iMacs.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5 (2.8 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / AMD Radeon R9 M370X or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Native Apple Silicon build recommended for best performance.
